refresh_catalog.label: Refresh machine catalog
refresh_catalog.description: Re-download the list of noise machines from mynoise.net. Normally refreshed automatically every 30 days.

patron_email.label: Patron email
patron_email.description: Email address associated with your myNoise donation. Fill in to unlock the patron-only Magic machines. Leave empty to use the free catalog only.

master_gain_db.label: Master gain (dB)
master_gain_db.description: Extra gain applied to the final mix of every machine. Use this if machines play too loud/quiet (start with -6).

use_variant_b.label: Use alternate sample takes
use_variant_b.description: myNoise ships two takes of every layer; the website picks one at random. Enable to always use the B-variant.
